nominal_units: Solar masses per square parsec projected on sky; no cos(inclination) deprojection.
stellar_conversion: 704.04 Lsun/pc2 per MJy/sr times assumed mass-to-light ratio; stellar map is flux, not preconverted mass.

registration.name: NGC2903
registration.source_selection: Only object passing stellar-gaia-alignment-001 strict holdout gate.
registration.relative_registration: Prior source-only diagnostic found P5->P1 shift (-3,-1) P1 pixels. Freeze this correction; fit flux scale/background on alternating 80-pixel blocks and evaluate the other blocks. Source-only development validation, not a pristine holdout.
registration.stellar_mask: All nonzero ICA mask labels excluded, including negative recursive-ICA labels, per publisher README.
registration.uncertainties: Parameter ranges are illustrative source-conversion sensitivity, not confidence intervals. CO propagated error uses fully correlated-noise upper bound, not independence.
limits: Projected surface mass only, not volume density.
CO integration windows partly depend on HI mean velocity, so tracer products are not fully independent.
HI and stellar measurement uncertainty not fully propagated.
